title: Eval-agent verdict (v2)
description: Verdict v2 extends v1 with an optional suggested_fix field inside the verdict object. Only NER evaluators (person_ner, provenance_ner, contents_ner) may return a non-null fix; genre_classifier always returns null.

judge_id.description: Model id of the judge that produced this verdict (e.g. 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview').

candidate.description: Raw payload of the prediction being judged, as emitted by the pipeline.

name_ok.description: `unknown` is HARNESS-only: it means the judge did not answer this axis (Rule W-158). _load_schema() strips it before the responseSchema, so the model is never offered it.

type_ok.description: `unknown` is HARNESS-only: it means the judge did not answer this axis (Rule W-158). _load_schema() strips it before the responseSchema, so the model is never offered it.

role_ok.description: `unknown` is HARNESS-only: it means the judge did not answer this axis (Rule W-158). _load_schema() strips it before the responseSchema, so the model is never offered it.

overall.description: The judge may only emit full / partial / fail; `pass` and `abstain` come from evaluators that grade on a two-way axis, and `verification_failed` is set by the HARNESS when the judge did not answer (Rule W-158). _load_schema() narrows this enum to the judge-emittable values before it becomes a responseSchema, so the model is never offered the harness-only ones.

reasoning.description: Why the verdict is what it is. Required to be non-empty for a substantive overall — see the top-level allOf.

suggested_fix.description: Optional high-confidence corrected entity text. null by default. Only permitted when the correction is directly visible in the provided MARC context and confidence is high. Never for wrong role/type only.

reasoning.description: Why this fix was proposed, citing the MARC evidence.

source_field.description: The MARC field key from which the correction was derived.

confidence.description: Only 'high' fixes are permitted. Medium/low are rejected.

error.description: If present, the verdict object is a placeholder and judging failed.

agentic.description: True when produced by the agentic tool-loop; false or absent for linear single-shot.

allOf.description: A substantive verdict must explain itself. An unexplained fail is not actionable by a curator, and was how a judge failure used to be indistinguishable from a rejection (Rule W-158).
A verification_failed verdict must carry the envelope-level error that explains it, so the failure is never silent.
